stages.goal: Build every remaining model component and the paper tooling in parallel; measure the gene-activity ATAC panel.

lanes.name: mil
lanes.goal: Professor D1 (loss refinements): conditional gradient-reversal nuisance adversary (N6) and RNA-ATAC InfoNCE pairing loss (N7), both pluggable into train_mil as aux losses.

lanes.name: tokens
lanes.goal: Professor D3 (granular tokens): training-only NMF gene-program tokens and ATAC region-module tokens with a matched token-concat control.
lanes.extra: Do not edit src/p22/models/mil.py or src/p22/training/*; the mil lane owns them. Your models must work inside MILWrapper as it exists on this branch.

lanes.name: atac
lanes.goal: Gene-activity ATAC panel (gene body +/- 2 kb) for gene-aligned cross-attention (Professor D3, D6). The only network step of the study, capped at 3.5e9 bytes.
lanes.extra: N20 quantification uses --workers 8 (network threads, light CPU). Write counts to reports/generated/nn_20260923/gene_activity/. Never raise the 3.5e9 byte budget.

lanes.name: paper0
lanes.goal: Paper tooling and the result-independent sections: checker (P1), figure script with the planted-benchmark figure (P2), Introduction + Related work (N28).
lanes.extra: P1 = decision_tree N31 checker features (1)-(5), stdlib only, parse citekeys from paper/refs_frozen.bib with regex @\w+\{([^,]+), (entries may be on one line). P2 = paper/make_figures.py with a --only planted mode that builds Fig 2 from docs/nn_v2/planted_benchmark.json (matplotlib Agg backend). N28: create paper/draft.md with a header comment, section headings (Abstract, Introduction, Related Work, Methods, Results, Discussion, Limitations, References) and write ONLY Introduction and Related Work. Framing must stay neutral (the question 'when does cross-modal attention help on paired single-cell RNA+ATAC?'); no result claims.

stages.goal: Freeze the NN-v2 protocol, then run the primary donor-held-out ladder on real DS data.

lanes.name: ladder
lanes.goal: Professor D1 + D5: frozen, apple-to-apple ladder R0-R4 of cross-attention vs matched token-concat, plus linear, pseudobulk, chr21, latent and majority controls; primary contrast with donor-bootstrap CI.
lanes.extra: Save every fold model state_dict plus its fold preprocessing evidence (selected genes, regions, scaler/IDF/NMF parameters, grid point) under reports/generated/nn_20260923/ladder/models/<arm>/r<rep>_f<fold>.pt and .json; N13 and N15 in stage S3 reload them instead of refitting. Runner flags --arms, --repeats, --resume, --workers, --exclude-chr21, --model-seed, --sampling-seed must exist (S3 lanes use them). Use at most 14 worker processes, 1 torch thread each.

stages.goal: Robustness, faithfulness, per-cell export, gene-aligned rerun and Methods text in parallel, all from the frozen S2 outputs.

lanes.name: robust
lanes.goal: Professor D13 + D9: chr21-excluded sensitivity and init/sampling-seed sensitivity with the same frozen estimand.
lanes.extra: Outputs under reports/generated/nn_20260923/chr21_excluded/ and .../seeds/. Write the reading into docs/nn_v2/ROBUSTNESS.md, not LADDER.md.

lanes.name: faith
lanes.goal: Professor D9 + D1: held-out interventions (branch ablation, within donor x cell-type ATAC permutation, attention knockout, uniform MIL pooling, gate clamp, no-op and planted positive control) and nuisance probes.
lanes.extra: Reload fold models from reports/generated/nn_20260923/ladder/models/; refit only if a model file is missing (deterministic, recorded grid point).

lanes.name: export
lanes.goal: Professor D2 input: out-of-fold per-cell DS-state scores and MIL attention for every sampled cell.
lanes.extra: Write the full table to reports/generated/nn_20260923/spectrum/cell_scores.csv.gz. Also export the same table for the chr21-excluded arms if their models exist; otherwise record NOT_NEEDED for that part.

lanes.name: geneact
lanes.goal: Professor D3 + D6: gene-aligned cross-attention (RNA gene g attends to ATAC gene-activity g and genomic neighbours) vs matched token-concat on the gene-activity panel. Secondary analysis.
lanes.extra: If tasks/nn/status/N20 is not DONE, write NOT_NEEDED:upstream N20 <status> to tasks/nn/status/N21 and stop. Do not edit scripts/run_nn_v2_comparison.py (robust lane owns it); import its functions instead.

lanes.name: paper1
lanes.goal: Methods section of paper/draft.md from the frozen protocol, inputs and amendments.
lanes.extra: Edit ONLY the Methods section of paper/draft.md.

stages.goal: Cell-state spectrum, attention description, the results document and full verification.

lanes.name: interpret
lanes.goal: Professor D2 (cell-state spectrum), D9 (attention only where interventions show use), D11 (clear written conclusion); results doc and unsent professor note.

stages.goal: Rule-based framing and a complete, checked first draft paper.

lanes.name: paper
lanes.goal: First draft paper (DRAFT_V1) that traces every number to docs/nn_v2 evidence and cites only paper/refs_frozen.bib.
lanes.extra: One section per iteration. Run python paper/check_paper.py after every section once N31 starts. N33 is the only write allowed outside the worktree.
